description: Avoid visible sidebar creation lag when switching windows by creating sidebar panes for all existing windows when sidebar mode is enabled, and by pre-creating the sidebar immediately for newly created windows while sidebar mode is active. Keep window switches as focus-only operations once the sidebar exists. Acceptance: the first switch into an already-open window does not create or resize a sidebar pane, and sidebar-enabled new windows arrive with the sidebar already present.
title: Prewarm tmux sidebar panes across windows
